claims.statement: If A is real symmetric, s3(A)>=1, H=A-diag(A), and s2(H)>tau for 0<tau<1, then with beta=tau/4, alpha=(1-beta)/2, gamma=(1-beta)/4 there is an original-coordinate cut C=A[L,R] such that either s2(C)>=beta; or s1(C)>beta plus a physical pivot |Aii|>=alpha on one side; or s1(C)>beta plus a nested physical cross bank of singular value >gamma.
In the two-direction branch there are physical two-color partitions of the two sides carrying squared 2x2 determinant mass at least beta^4/4.

forbidden_inferences_retained: same-square absorption of arbitrary same-bank curvature
